clear_playlist.docs: This action will clear the media player's playlist.

enqueue.docs: This action will add the specified media to the media player's queue.

group_join.docs: This action will join the media player to a group.

mute.docs: This action will mute the media player.

next.docs: This action will skip to the next track.

pause.docs: This action pauses the current playback.

play.docs: This action will resume playing the media player.

play_media.docs: This action will start playing the specified media.

previous.docs: This action will skip to the previous track.

repeat_all.docs: This action will set the media player to repeat all tracks.

repeat_off.docs: This action will turn off repeat mode.

repeat_one.docs: This action will set the media player to repeat the current track.

shuffle.docs: This action will enable shuffle mode.

stop.docs: This action stops the current playback.

toggle.docs: This action will pause or resume the current playback.

turn_off.docs: This action will turn off the media player.

turn_on.docs: This action will turn on the media player.

unmute.docs: This action will unmute the media player.

unshuffle.docs: This action will disable shuffle mode.

volume_down.docs: This action will decrease the volume of the media player.

volume_set.docs: This action will set the volume of the media player.

volume_up.docs: This action will increase the volume of the media player.

speaker.docs:
The `speaker` media player platform allows you to play on-device and online audio media via [speaker components](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/).

*See also: [Speaker Audio Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker)*

speaker_source.docs:
The `speaker_source` media player platform orchestrates [media source](https://esphome.io/components/media_source/) components that produce audio. When a media URL is received, the platform routes it to the appropriate source based on the URI prefix. For example, a URL starting with `audio-file://` is handled by the [Audio File media source](https://esphome.io/components/media_source/audio_file/).

*See also: [Speaker Source Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker_source)*

is_announcing.docs: This condition checks if the media player is playing an announcement.

is_idle.docs: This condition checks if the media player is idle.

is_muted.docs: This condition checks if the media player is muted.

is_off.docs: This condition checks if the media player is turned off.

is_on.docs: This condition checks if the media player is turned on.

is_paused.docs: This condition checks if the media player is paused.

is_playing.docs: This condition checks if the media player is playing media.

on_turn_off.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when media_player is turned off, implements the `supports_turn_off_on` trait.

*See also: [Speaker Audio Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker#configuration-variables)*

on_turn_on.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when media_player is turned on, implements the `supports_turn_off_on` trait.

*See also: [Speaker Audio Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**string**: Manually specify the ID for code generation. At least one of **id** and **name** must be specified.

*See also: [Media Player Components](https://esphome.io/components/media_player#base-media-player-configuration)*

name.docs:
**string**: The name of the media player. At least one of **id** and **name** must be specified.

*See also: [Media Player Components](https://esphome.io/components/media_player#base-media-player-configuration)*

icon.docs:
**icon**: Manually set the icon to use for the media player in the frontend.

*See also: [Media Player Components](https://esphome.io/components/media_player#base-media-player-configuration)*

internal.docs:
**boolean**: Mark this component as internal. Internal components will not be exposed to the frontend (like Home Assistant). Only specifying an `id` without a `name` will implicitly set this to true.

*See also: [Media Player Components](https://esphome.io/components/media_player#base-media-player-configuration)*

disabled_by_default.docs:
**boolean**: If true, then this entity should not be added to any client's frontend, (usually Home Assistant) without the user manually enabling it (via the Home Assistant UI). Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Media Player Components](https://esphome.io/components/media_player#base-media-player-configuration)*

entity_category.docs:
**string**: The category of the entity. See [https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#generic-properties](https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#generic-properties) for a list of available options. Set to `""` to remove the default entity category.

*See also: [Media Player Components](https://esphome.io/components/media_player#base-media-player-configuration)*
